body.objective: Decide whether the exact non-split RW/RW/spin-one filtration upgrades the reduced positive-potential no-growth result to the complete six-state axial ell=2 separated boundary problem.
body.stop_condition: In the repository convention exp(+i omega t), certify or refuse that every filtration inclusion, quotient and master map preserves the future-horizon-regular and zero-incoming/pure-outgoing germ classes for Im(omega)<0. If preservation and endpoint kernel exactness pass, use successive quotient elimination and the nonnegative spin-two and spin-one Regge-Wheeler operators to classify growing separated modes of the full six-state system. Define the intrinsic regularized Evans product and record, without selecting, the exact local extension/Smith gate at a simple damped spin-two QNM.
body.current_gate: Complex-frequency boundary devissage, complete separated-mode no-growth theorem, and intrinsic Evans/extension claim boundary
body.forbid: no time-domain boundedness, decay, completeness or full PDE stability theorem; no absence of damped upper-half-plane quasinormal modes; no classification of omega=i/4,i/2,i as Evans zeros or nonzeros; no claimed spectral-derivative identity or nonzero extension invariant before computation; no polar, general-ell, CPT, particle, ghost or unitarity promotion
body.resource_hint: Use the exact J, K and U chain maps and the weighted spin-one master y=r^2(r-2)K_0(state). Growth is Im(omega)<0. The physical radial factors are exp(+i omega rstar) at the future horizon and exp(-i omega rstar) for pure outgoing infinity. On the simultaneous two-ended kernel, left exactness and kernel identification suffice; do not claim quotient surjectivity.
notes: The intrinsic factor Evans product is A_in_2^2 A_in_1.
At a simple damped spin-two zero, the extension class [c] in O/(A_in_2) controls the local Smith type.
The spectral-derivative congruence is a next test, not an established identity.
